question: Can the completed U1 physical matter metric be represented in standard scalar Newtonian coordinates while retaining the preferred-foliation information in a separate Stückelberg field, and do the already-reduced U1 constraints give Newtonian matter potentials without introducing a B-prime evolution variable?

conventions.physical_scalar_metric: ds^2=a^2[-(1+2Phi)deta^2+2 partial_i B dx^i deta+((1-2Psi)delta_ij+2 partial_i partial_j E)dx^i dx^j]

preferred_foliation_stueckelberg.definition: Introduce a separate scalar T_fol=eta+chi that covariantizes the preferred foliation; chi=0 in preferred/unitary coordinates.
preferred_foliation_stueckelberg.strict_non_identification: T_fol/chi is not the RTK/DBI scalar Sigma and is not the U1 Newtonian prepotential varphi. No identification is allowed without a separately frozen action hypothesis.

existing_traceless_solve: deltaA=Ahat psi+a[8 pi G a^2 Pi_total+B_prime+2H B-psi+Pcal phi-alpha1 Lpsi]
acceptance: derive Phi_N=Phi_matter+H sigma+sigma_prime and Psi_N=Psi_matter-H sigma
on the frozen quasilongitudinal Ahat=0 branch set sigma=B
substitute the existing exact traceless deltaA solve into Phi_N and prove all B_prime terms cancel identically
derive Phi_N=(1-Pcal)phi+psi+alpha1 Lpsi-H B-8 pi G a^2 Pi_total
derive the slip Phi_N-Psi_N=(1-Pcal)phi+alpha1 Lpsi-8 pi G a^2 Pi_total, independent of B and B_prime
show chi_N=B carries the preferred-foliation information after the coordinate representation is made Newtonian
state that this is a coordinate/Stueckelberg representation, not an allowed local-time FDiff gauge fixing of the unitary-gauge Hořava action
do not declare a CLASS implementation complete until total source variables are transformed consistently and the transformed algebraic system is pole-audited

decision.if_pass: Freeze a total-source transformation and transformed-constraint pole audit. A future CLASS bridge may feed standard Newtonian matter potentials while retaining chi/B internally in the completed gravity solver.
decision.if_fail: Use a shear-aware Boltzmann hierarchy directly in preferred coordinates instead of standard CLASS Newtonian representation.

non_claims: not a proof that the transformed completed gravity equations equal GR
not a proof that chi is dynamically zero
not a new physical degree of freedom count
not an identification of the preferred-foliation Stückelberg with the RTK scalar Sigma
